measurement: Fresh processes, same fixed traces, rotating candidate order; no compile/tests concurrent; first repeat independently verified outside timing
baseline: Published endpoint/alignment implementation for leaf report; copy_bitcache intermediate implementation for leafsplit/pow reports
decision: Leaf-only chunking lowers ordinary RSS but slows several conditions and adds pool-management code. Leaf-first lazy updates and conditional-child updates do not consistently beat copy_bitcache. These candidates are not adopted.
